ready1_open_rewrite.rewritten_question_text: Read the figure. In the figure, line segments 1, 2, 3, and 4 are all ocean currents in this ocean. <image1> In July, dense fog often appears in the sea area where ocean current 1 is located. From the perspective of the water-vapor conditions over the sea area, what is the cause of its formation?
ready1_open_rewrite.expected_answer: In July the temperature is relatively high, evaporation is vigorous, and water vapor over the sea area is sufficient.
